test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The population of a city increases every year at the rate of 5%. If the population of the city is 16000, what will be the population after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial population of the city = 16000

Rate of increase per year = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Future Population = Present Population × (1 + Rate of Increase)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

n = Number of years = 2

Rate of Increase = 5% = 0.05

Future Population = 16000 × (1 + 0.05)²

⇒ Future Population = 16000 × (1.05)²

⇒ Future Population = 16000 × 1.1025

⇒ Future Population = 17640

**The population after 2 years will be 17640.**
